```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ---- ONE-TIME INSTALLS (run in Console, NOT here) ----
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "pheatmap"))
# BiocManager::install(c("DESeq2", "airway"))
# Optional (gene symbols + GO enrichment):
# BiocManager::install(c("org.Hs.eg.db", "clusterProfiler"))

library(airway)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)

set.seed(42)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5, dpi = 150)

# Output folders (relative to code/ folder)
fig_dir <- file.path("..", "figures")
res_dir <- file.path("..", "results")
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(res_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# 1. Data import

```{r import}
data("airway")                      # RangedSummarizedExperiment object
se <- airway

dim(se)                             # genes x samples
as.data.frame(colData(se)) %>%
  select(SampleName, cell, dex, Run)  # sample metadata
```

# 2. Cleaning and quality control

```{r qc}
# Set "untrt" as reference level
se$dex <- relevel(se$dex, ref = "untrt")

# Build DESeq2 object: control for cell line, test treatment
dds <- DESeqDataSet(se, design = ~ cell + dex)

# Remove low-count genes
n_before <- nrow(dds)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 4, ]
cat("Genes before:", n_before, "| after filtering:", nrow(dds), "\n")

# Library sizes
lib <- tibble(sample = colnames(dds),
              reads  = colSums(counts(dds)),
              dex    = dds$dex)

p_lib <- ggplot(lib, aes(sample, reads / 1e6, fill = dex)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Library size per sample", x = NULL, y = "Million reads") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
p_lib
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "01_library_size.png"), p_lib, width = 7, height = 4)
```

# 3. Exploratory analysis

```{r eda}
# Variance-stabilising transformation for visualisation
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)

# PCA
pca <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("dex", "cell"), returnData = TRUE)
pct <- round(100 * attr(pca, "percentVar"))

p_pca <- ggplot(pca, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = dex, shape = cell)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  labs(title = "PCA of VST-transformed counts",
       x = paste0("PC1: ", pct[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", pct[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_minimal()
p_pca
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "02_pca.png"), p_pca, width = 7, height = 5)

# Sample-to-sample distance heatmap
dist_mat <- as.matrix(dist(t(assay(vsd))))
rownames(dist_mat) <- paste(vsd$dex, vsd$cell, sep = "-")
colnames(dist_mat) <- NULL

ph1 <- pheatmap(dist_mat, main = "Sample distances", silent = TRUE)
png(file.path(fig_dir, "03_sample_distance.png"),
    width = 1000, height = 800, res = 150)
grid::grid.draw(ph1$gtable)
dev.off()
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(ph1$gtable)
```

# 4. Differential expression (DESeq2)

```{r deseq}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("dex", "trt", "untrt"), alpha = 0.05)
summary(res)

res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl") %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Optional: add gene symbols if org.Hs.eg.db is installed
if (requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  res_df$symbol <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = res_df$ensembl, keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")
} else {
  res_df$symbol <- NA_character_
}
res_df$label <- ifelse(is.na(res_df$symbol), res_df$ensembl, res_df$symbol)

write_csv(res_df, file.path(res_dir, "DE_results_dex_vs_untrt.csv"))
head(res_df, 10)
```
